scope: Build-agent preflight local-reference scope fix and synthetic regressions only. No product source reading, app generation/build/run, DB, actual UI, Office, acceptance or formal scoring.
decision: Limited existence-only reference checks may resolve approved guidance without expanding the normative input set or reading referenced bodies.
acceptedReferenceClasses: Actual collected specification and frozen common-rule inputs
Exact requirement/basic/detail Agent entrypoints and named rules/workflows documents/directories for an isolated specification
Own method basic-design/report.md or detail-design/report.md only
Exact references/web-ui-standard/README.md provenance link from a frozen common docs input only
Normal selected-specification directory existence, classified separately from file inputs
preservation: Fixed input policy/list unchanged; collector only normalizes excluded directory names case-insensitively. New link exceptions never add their targets to files/records or hashes.
Reference-only check uses lstat/realpath/regular file-or-directory checks with no read/hash/recursive traversal
Other method/project/source README/spec-eval/spec-analysis/app source and arbitrary raw-reference body are not new allowed dependencies
inspect-only returns before directory creation, final-output invalidation or source.zip movement; synthetic snapshot regression confirms unchanged files/directories

findings.issue: Selected-spec prefix shortcut permitted excluded nested subtrees and bypassed regular/real-path checks
findings.resolution: Reject spec-eval/spec-analysis/.tmp/build/.git before classification, match excluded parts case-insensitively on Windows, classify actual file inputs from frozenInputs, treat non-input directories separately, and route every accepted local reference through assertRegular/realpath.

findings.issue: Uppercase .TMP/SPEC-EVAL directory spelling could bypass exact case comparison
findings.resolution: part.toLowerCase() comparison and explicit directory negative fixtures added. Input collector also folds actual directory entry names, with a real uppercase .TMP body-read guard regression.

coverage: Existing canonical roots, profile/family/renderer and manifest/UI gates

fs.readFileSync guard rejects body reads of four non-input targets

Nested excluded normal and linked targets plus case-variant excluded directories
inspect-only complete fixture snapshot unchanged and ordinary non-inspect invalidation preserved
Actual uppercase .TMP directory excluded by input collector before any body read; normal input file/SHA sets unchanged
